content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, brushing against his arm ||| "What if I told you I know the truth?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his ||| "I won’t answer that until I understand the stakes."  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his gaze, my voice steady ||| "I’m scared of what this means for us."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip The Answer tighter, my resolve firm ||| "I’ll answer your questions, but only on my terms."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, taking a deep breath ||| *Silence*
